history.summary: A 26-unit freehold boutique in Siglap (confirmed via search) where the $1,295 PSF looks cheap only because the 1,776 sqft unit is oversized. The 6.4%/yr URA rate rests on just 5 transactions and the micro-development is inherently illiquid despite the new Siglap TEL station.
history.rating_rationale: Only 26 units total and ura_txn_count of 5 — appreciation (6.4%) is statistically unreliable and exit risk is high. $2.3M quantum on a 1,776 sqft unit means $1,295 PSF, below the $1,473 median, but the discount is for the large/older format, not a steal. Score_1000 of 494 is sub-market. Siglap MRT (730m, TEL) is a real plus that keeps this from Avoid.
red_flags: 26-unit boutique — very thin liquidity, no facilities scale
$2.3M quantum on an oversized unit narrows the buyer pool
catalysts: Siglap TEL MRT 730m away (opened/recent) — connectivity uplift
Freehold in established Upper East Coast enclave
